question: What were the operator's interventions about, and what does planning already hold for each subject?
method: The 298 survey episodes holding a correction or a failure instruction (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28, 72 orders) were read by two agents that named each episode's subject in their own words with a theme key, a layer (subject, meta, meta-meta) and a fix target; one agent consolidated the keys into themes and mapped each to the register, the planning map, work orders, product documents and role skills, with a next step. The operator's own readings of sampled messages and WO-172's corrected handling failures were given as authoritative. Orders, dates and recurrence after the fixing order's final review are computed from the survey's episodes and the control logs. Themes, counts and identifiers only; no message text. Repair F2/F3 retains those themes and recomputes their counts from send-time episodes split by role; repair records the exact effect. Repair F4/F5 keeps those themes, carries each through the regenerated episodes and places four pieces that hold a question-tool answer by the executor's reading; the repair block records the exact effect.
status: The executor's reading through agents; the operator accepted the map as good for now at 2026-09-29T05:01Z by the prompt hook's clock and may correct any theme later (WO-172-D022).

themes.title: Gates rerun in loops or run slowly
themes.description: Roles rerun the product or evidence gate after changes that should not need it, restart multi-run series after trivial edits, or sit on gates the machinery made slow, and the operator had to break the cycle repeatedly.
themes.coverageEvidence: Product 07 'Write once, run once' (lines 1910-1941) keys the gate by code identity (WO-132, closed 2026-09-15T17:05Z) and adds WO-173's lookup that exits when a passing row covers the same identity (closed 2026-09-28T22:24Z). Nine episodes fall between the two and none after WO-173; failures §13 (lines 656-660) reopens the structural cut if an order still pays over four gate runs.
themes.nextStep: At the next pass, count product gate runs per order since WO-173 from the gate index, as failures §3 did; reopen the structural-cut item if any order exceeds four (§13), and triage FUP-7629e03c6573f5cb's untracked-source reuse gap.

themes.coverageEvidence: Product 07 (lines 1444-1472) says to decide and continue within authority (landed 2026-09-09) and not to ask for routine release numbers, but Adjacent Repair and Intent to Act are equipped only for the executor; rule 6 (a step the executor can perform is the executor's) sits in sequence.md lines 15-20 with its product 07 home pending as FUP-a9412a7815418c21. Failures §7 counts settled matters put back to the operator, three times in WO-163.
themes.nextStep: Triage FUP-a9412a7815418c21: move rule 6 into product 07 §Discipline and the shared role text (contributor.ts common) so every role, not only the executor, settles routine version, waiver and live-episode questions itself (E0975, E0980, E0987).

WO-172-D019 records the rule to classify faithfully and confirm the reading; FUP-0c76cd39223a576b (untriaged) asks for the operator's own classes.
themes.nextStep: Extend the executor-only Intent to Act support to the planner, verifier and reviewer in packages/skeleton/src/loadouts/contributor.ts so each states its reading of the operator's aim before acting, and score misreads against the operator's reading once FUP-0c76cd39223a576b is allocated.

refCheck: Every cited FUP id (44), order (63) and file and line reference (74) was checked against the register, the work-order index and the files on 2026-09-29; none was missing.

repair.rule: Split a session episode at an order or role change before comparison; preserve its existing theme for each split piece. The accepted 30-theme interpretation and next steps are unchanged; this is a count reconciliation, not a fresh operator endorsement.

repair2.rule: A piece that holds a retained message keeps the theme of the piece that message stood in. An added question-tool answer that joins two pieces makes them one. A piece that holds only added answers, or that becomes a failure instruction through one, has no theme to inherit; the executor read it and placed it in one of the accepted 30 themes. The themes and next steps are unchanged; the four readings are the executor's and not the operator's.

read.reading: a verifier put the recording of its verdict back to the operator as options
a stale lock blocked the verification
the recommended option passed the order and nominated a failure the verifier had reproduced
three verifications had passed on a gate that did not select the failing suite
